cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(cad_to_urdf_glue)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(pluginlib REQUIRED)
find_package(mujoco_ros2_control_plugins REQUIRED)
find_package(mujoco_vendor REQUIRED)  # defines mujoco::mujoco (its ament export has a relative lib path)
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED src/glue_plugin.cpp)
target_compile_features(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} mujoco::mujoco)
ament_target_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} rclcpp std_msgs geometry_msgs pluginlib mujoco_ros2_control_plugins)
pluginlib_export_plugin_description_file(mujoco_ros2_control_plugins plugins.xml)
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
ament_package()
